regular_square_grid_necessary_envelope.scope: Optimistic necessary bound for regular square interior grid: spacing=2L, area=4L². Maximizes q/area across original catalogue segments with both operating flows in range. Ignores lower ratio limit and minimum-load curve test; not a sufficient design, arbitrary-layout bound or measured comfort prediction.

load_assumptions.minimum_load_basis: Declared constant-temperature-difference scenario: inherited 40% flow corresponds to 40% sensible load; actual part-load room load unverified

scope: Paired published-load curve diagnostic at fixed inherited thermal/airflow assumptions; not interpolation to actual room load, measured ADPI, installed layout or engineering acceptance
lengths_scope: Actual polygon wall-ray and exactly aligned opposing-midplane diagnostic proxies; physical wall/jet/ceiling applicability remains unknown
source_curve_margin_scope: Full source stroke-width margin in both axes; not source testing/measurement/installation uncertainty
